lines.en: I walk with my head crooked.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿走起来不太对
lines.en: One of my legs moves wrong.

lines.zh: 我的脚步拖着，草被压倒
lines.en: My steps drag and flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 我的身体在走路时抖了一下
lines.en: My body shudders as I walk.
I come toward you, not fast.
My hands hang loose at my sides.
I walk crooked, but never off course.

lines.zh: 我从林子边上慢慢过来
lines.en: I come slowly along the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我的影子在动，身体也在动
lines.en: My shadow moves, and so does my body.
I stop and go, like something breaking up.
Dead this time, my mouth still open.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上拖出一条线
lines.en: My foot drags a line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我站着，脸上的东西在动
lines.en: I stand, and something on my face moves.
My head drops a little.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把手抬起来，演出还没结束。
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly; the scene is not over.
Something runs from me, and it is not blood.
My outline is not steady.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里漏出一声低响。
lines.en: A low sound leaks from my throat.

lines.zh: 树林里的光在我身上断开
lines.en: The light breaks over me.

lines.zh: 我在原地摆了一下身体
lines.en: I sway once in place.
I turn my head, very slowly.
My hand rises and falls.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听风穿过断枝。
lines.en: Head tilted, I listen to wind through broken branches.
My body feels badly joined.

lines.zh: 我站在树的影子里不动
lines.en: I stand still in the tree's shadow.
My mouth opens, dark inside.

lines.zh: 我抬起脸，露出不该有的东西
lines.en: I raise my face and show what should not be there.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你记得的多
lines.en: I have more eyes than you remember.
You step back, so I come forward.
My mouth is open, and silent.
My hand jerks at my side.
Even the fall must be performed to the end.

lines.zh: 你认得这张脸，可它不对
lines.en: You know this face, and it is wrong.
My body wavers before you.
I raise a hand, one joint too many.

lines.zh: 你听见嗡嗡的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear that humming?
I come one step closer.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上拉得很长
lines.en: My shadow stretches long.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候脸不太听话
lines.en: When I smile, my face does not obey.
You are looking at my eyes.
I bring my face close to you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛里有什么在游
lines.en: Something swims in my eyes.
I know your face well.
I raise a hand and reach slowly.
My jaw hangs down.
I stay still and only look.
A corner of me is missing and the edges tremble.
I sag sideways and slowly straighten.
The sound I make goes higher.
My outline wavers.

lines.zh: 我的肩塌下去，慢慢鼓回来。
lines.en: My shoulder caves in, then slowly swells back.
I scatter and slowly regather.

lines.zh: 我倒下去的样子，你看着。
lines.en: Watch how I fall.
The sound I make cuts off.
I withdraw slowly into the tree shadow.
My fingers no longer bend.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西我不认得
lines.en: I do not know what you hold.
I reach out, fingers wrong.

lines.zh: 我拖着腿，朝你手里的东西去。
lines.en: Dragging a leg, I move toward what you hold.
Set it down; I will take it.
My neck bends wrong.
Do not fear; I only want to be near.
I reach with both hands.

lines.zh: 我的手抓了两次才抓到
lines.en: It takes me two tries to grasp it.
I press it to my chest.
I look down at it, head askew.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞到空的
lines.en: You hit me as if hitting something hollow.
My hand slides over your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，身体抖了一下
lines.en: I give half a step and shudder.

lines.zh: 我们撞开的草没再起来
lines.en: The grass we part does not rise again.
One touch and I come apart a little.
You touch me and pull back, as if I might break.

lines.zh: 我的身体在你手上变形
lines.en: My body deforms under your hand.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的头转了一圈
lines.en: We meet and my head turns a full circle.
I tip over a little to one side.
My hand catches your sleeve.
Another one is twisting too.

lines.zh: 我们对着歪头，角度一样
lines.en: We tilt our heads at the same angle.
Its face is wrong too.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，声音叠着
lines.en: We lean together, our sounds overlapping.
There are no words between us.

lines.zh: 它把手伸过来，也是歪的
lines.en: It reaches out, also crooked.
We sway together, out of time.
It leans on my shoulder, very light.
Our sounds mingle.

lines.zh: 它没有脸，却朝我这边偏
lines.en: It has no face, yet it turns my way.
I bend, and bend too far.

lines.zh: 我两根手指夹起它，抖了一下。
lines.en: I pinch it between two fingers and twitch.
I hold it to my face; I cannot see well.

lines.zh: 我把它放进嘴里，又吐出来
lines.en: I put it in my mouth and spit it out.
I crouch, and stay too long.
I curl a finger around it.
I bring it to my mouth.
It slips, and I pick it up again.

lines.zh: 我把它捧在手里，手在抖
lines.en: I cup it in my hands, and my hands shake.
I hold it to the light.
I stop, and my head keeps moving.
I lean your way.
I begin an unsteady advance.

lines.zh: 我身上还在冒电，退不了。
lines.en: Sparks still crawl on me; I cannot stop.
I stop and lean forward.

lines.zh: 十根指头，一根根向外撑开。
lines.en: Ten fingers splay outward, one by one.
My head is square to you now.
I no longer walk crooked.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边歪着头，腿不太对。
lines.en: I walk with my head tilted, one leg wrong.
I begin to speed up.
My mouth opens wider.
I put out one hand toward you.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到你脚下
lines.en: My shadow is already at your feet.
I do not need to run.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟碰到树根，我听见了。
lines.en: Your heel knocks a root; I heard it.
My body steadies a moment.
I come on, steps uneven.
You look back; I sway in place.
I follow, speed unchanging.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步声，不是节奏
lines.en: You hear steps, but no rhythm.
I follow, crookedly.
You go left; I lean left.
My hand stays out toward you.
You reach a tree and it creaks.

lines.zh: 我一步一歪，可方向没错。
lines.en: I lurch with every step, but the heading is right.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上拖出声音
lines.en: My feet drag sound on the ground.
You look back and my pose has changed.
My head turns before my body.
I keep following, never leaving.
You follow the sound to find me.
I am just behind your flank.
You circle once and I am still there.
My shadow crawls ahead of you.
You go deeper into the wood.
I move along the trees.

lines.zh: 你停住，我的动作也停住
lines.en: You halt, and my movement halts.
My hand falls from above.
My hand closes on your arm.
One collision and I am twisted.
I press against you, trembling.
My hand comes down.
I swing, and the motion breaks.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你背上合拢
lines.en: My fingers close on your back.
I charge, shoulder first.
I grab, and my grip slides off.

lines.zh: 我的第二下比第一下歪
lines.en: My second blow is more crooked than the first.
I pull you toward the tree.
My head hits your chest.
You block my hand, and it passes through.

lines.zh: 我抓空的时候身体散了
lines.en: When I miss, my body comes apart.
I press against you, and I am cold.
I strike and withdraw far.

lines.zh: 林子里的光先断了一下
lines.en: The light in the wood breaks first.
I take shape, very slowly.
A hand appears first.
My head turns last.

lines.zh: 我站在那儿，像没有骨头
lines.en: I stand there as if boneless.

lines.zh: 你在远处看见我，就别过来了
lines.en: If you see me from afar, do not come closer.
The air shivers first.

lines.zh: 我先是一团不定的东西
lines.en: I begin as something unformed.
I slowly draw out a shape.

lines.zh: 我的头是最后一个成形的
lines.en: My head is the last part to form.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，脚下没有影子
lines.en: I stand here with no shadow at my feet.

lines.zh: 虫鸣一下子断了，我来了。
lines.en: The insects cut off at once; I have arrived.
I raise a hand, not yet steady.

lines.zh: 我的脖子先转，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My neck turns first, my body follows.
My mouth opens first.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚往前挪了一步
lines.en: I drag my feet one step forward.

lines.zh: 我经过的草弯下去不复原
lines.en: The grass bends where I pass and stays bent.

lines.zh: 我的身体在空气里响了一下
lines.en: My body gives a sound in the air.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向有光的一边
lines.en: I turn my face toward the light.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，等你看见我
lines.en: I stand here until you see me.

lines.zh: 火碰到我，我的身体就断开了
lines.en: Fire touches me and my body comes apart.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下去，落地没声音
lines.en: I fall from height and land silently.

lines.zh: 水把我冲散，我抓不住形状
lines.en: Water scatters me; I cannot hold a shape.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的身体撕开一块
lines.en: The blast tears a piece out of me.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，留下一个空
lines.en: Something passes through me, leaving a gap.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的动作停住
lines.en: That force stops my movements.

lines.zh: 我一点力气也没有，走得像拖
lines.en: I have no strength; I move like something dragged.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮我，我整个白了一下
lines.en: Lightning lights me and I go white.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我散着落下去
lines.en: No ground below; I fall apart as I drop.
